label: preparing
what: A discreet coordinated gathering at the town hall at 18:00 today, involving 200 fresh loaves and a builder-arranged lighting review that brings me there. Builder accepted a 101-emerald committee debt, with innkeeper and freight coordinating bread supplies and baker involved in baking. Secretary helps coordinate appointments and obtain delivery/payment confirmations. It may celebrate my forty years as mayor, but that purpose remains speculation rather than confirmed knowledge.
